author: Whale__Warrior
body:
Name: bombs away

Aim of the game: one team has to transport the bomb (a crate place it in the opposing teams spawn area in a designated spot.

More detail: 
There will be classes and levels ( classes basically the same as nexus and there will be a shop with potions and golden apples in etc)
Once team called attackers spawn in a large air craft and have to jump out the back ( don't take fall damage )
One member of attackers will be placed with the crate named bomb , this'll be random.

The defenders have to prevent the attackers from getting the bomb to a spot you can only have 5 deaths for the carriers before the game ends

Bomb carriers have resistance 1 
When they die the another random player is selected

Any questions?
